item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #MINPRSD
Issued at 07:30 PM 04 September 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(Baungon, Sumilao), #LanaoDelSur(TagoloanII, Bubong, Maguing, BuadiposoBuntong, Mulondo, Taraka and DitsaanRamain) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Bukidnon(CityOfMalaybalay, Cabanglasan, Lantapan, ImpasugOng, Libona, ManoloFortich, Talakag), #AgusanDelSur(LaPaz and SanLuis) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
